message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes. All of them are located in the city proper (not in the suburbs) and have a good reputation for vegetarian options.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* |
| **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup, Tofu Massaman Curry, Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Satay.* |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Green Curry, Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* |
| **Thai House** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Tofu Satay.* |

> **Note:** All of the above restaurants are located on the same block (W 18th St), so you can easily walk between them. They all offer a range of vegetarian dishes, and many of them also have a separate vegetarian menu or can accommodate vegetarian requests upon order.

### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining at Thai Restaurants

1. **Ask for “No Meat” or “Vegetarian”** – Most Thai chefs are happy to adjust dishes to be vegetarian.  
2. **Check for “Tofu” or “Vegetable” versions** – Many classic dishes (Pad Thai, Massaman Curry, Tom Yum) have tofu or vegetable alternatives.  
3. **Look for “Satay” with tofu** – Satay is usually served with a peanut sauce; ask for tofu instead of chicken or pork.  
4. **Avoid “Khao Man Gai” (chicken rice)** – Instead, try “Khao Soi” with tofu or “Khao Pad” (fried rice) with vegetables.  

If you’d like to make a reservation or confirm the vegetarian options, you can call the restaurant directly or check their website for the most up-to-date menu. Enjoy your meal!
